zh.d:
本版带来全新的「场景」工作方式、知识库大升级（PDF 连续预览、离线 Office 预热、导入可取消、中文检索提速）与团队协作效率改进（自动编排、跟随队长模型、更快产出）。dream 引擎与内置模型依旧开箱即用，无需注册、无需粘贴 Key。

【新增】
· 【场景】从首页选择项目文件夹即可进入场景：场景对话知道自己所在的场景，首页草稿可带入场景，未动过的场景对话自动复用，场景聊天自动命名，也可以直接从场景页开始
· 【聊天过程】连续的思考与工具调用折叠为一条实时过程行；引擎在长任务过程中主动播报进度
· 【知识库·PDF】PDF 连续预览：适宽排版、拖拽平移、以光标位置为锚点缩放
· 【知识库·Office】离线 Office 引擎预热，打开文档先显示快照、引擎就绪后无缝可交互，并隐藏引擎自带的英文菜单与工具栏
· 【首页】引导页引擎胶囊最多显示五个，其余收进「更多」
· 【团队】队长可开启「自动编排」开关，由系统自动为团队配置成员

【优化改进】
· 【知识库】条目可从侧栏、文档页直接加入会话；库列表更紧凑，界面跟随应用主题
· 【知识库·检索】内存向量排序、覆盖索引与批量嵌入全面提速；中文问题按三元组匹配，本地模型使用更小分块；快速嵌入配置增加校验，模型通道复用
· 【知识库·导入】大批量导入可取消、不再卡死；原件分片读取、解析移入后台线程，不再重复下载原件；索引失败过的文件下次导入自动重新排队
· 【预览】文本预览上限从 1 MB 提高到 5 MB
· 【团队】成员尽早动笔、自检次数封顶、默认交付一份成果；取消无意义的欢迎轮，依赖经任务板流转；成员始终以用户语言回复
· 【数字员工】内置角色指南正确绑定，用户自定义设置升级后保留

【修复】
· 【团队】手动添加的专家与自动生成的成员跟随队长的真实模型（不再被名册种子误导）；成员选择器无需搜索即可列出全部专家
· 【团队/MCP】团队 MCP 撤销立即生效（含缓存工具与快照）；分布式团队技能正确解析并注入团队指引
· 【知识库】冷启动时的查询嵌入不再丢失；市场导入同名条目改为带来源标签命名导入，不再静默跳过
· 【机器人】配对审批重复提交时过期原因正确保留
· 【首页/侧栏】历史加载失败时给出明确提示；默认模型选择不再漂移
· 【技能】技能经命令行传递中文内容不再变成「?」（Windows 管道编码修复）
· 【稳定性】数据库文件损坏时明确报告原因，不再笼统报 500；升级依赖修复已知安全漏洞

企业治理全面加强：终端命令等待管理员审批时对话中明确提示，公司知识库支持文件存储整夹导入与 PDF 文本导入，审计日志可转发 SIEM；公司改名、目录同步、连接器与权限多处修复。

【新增】
· 【审批提示】终端命令等待公司管理员审批时，会话（含 ACP 会话）中明确说明等待原因，审批标题可读；过期的审批保留不再卡住会话
· 【知识库】已登记文件存储的整个文件夹可导入公司知识库；PDF 导入改为读取文本层，大文档在 CPU 服务器上完成嵌入；管理台可选取 .pdf 并说明可读取的内容
· 【审计】审计日志可转发到公司 SIEM，管理台显示转发是否真正送达
· 【连接器】连接器卡片保留检测结果并给出下一步建议，已保存的令牌掩码显示；GitHub/GitLab/Jira 以令牌而非主机可达性判定连通

【优化改进】
· 【管理台】企业存储与个人保险箱导航统一；本地工作台按标签整合相关功能；启动资源分拆、设置分区合并；成员表头精简，回到窗口不再整页重建
· 【管理台】嵌入配置简化，模型选择支持搜索；旧版浏览器用户在升级前获得引导

【修复】
· 【权限】员工分配与知识编辑权限收紧；企业知识索引限流、团队任务边界保留；管理员权限口径对齐
· 【目录】目录成员登录即完成绑定；同一秒内的多次目录同步不再混淆；公司权限与可搜索的目录成员映射对齐
· 【公司】公司改名同步到工作区名称
· 【MCP】公司 MCP 授权撤销后，缓存运行时立即退役
· 【SSO】SSO 配置位置保留，每次成功登录记入审计
· 【安全】IP 白名单拒绝会把自己锁在门外的配置；升级依赖修复已知安全漏洞
· 【存储】WebDAV 中含 # ? % 的文件名可正常读取；MySQL 迁移恢复可用；企业 PDF 不再依赖浏览器插件渲染；冲突草稿与仅源文档状态保留；市场同名条目标明「已导入为」的去向

en.d:
This release introduces Scenes, a major knowledge base upgrade (continuous PDF preview, prewarmed offline Office engine, cancellable imports, faster Chinese retrieval) and team collaboration improvements (auto staffing, leader-model following, faster delivery). The dream engine and built-in models still work out of the box, no sign-up and no API key needed.

[New]
· Scenes: open a project folder from the home page; scene conversations know their scene, home drafts carry over, untouched scene conversations are reused, scene chats are auto-titled, and you can start from the Scenes tab
· Chat: runs of thoughts and tool calls fold into one live process row; the engine narrates progress during long tasks
· Knowledge/PDF: continuous PDF preview with fit-width, drag-to-pan and cursor-anchored zoom
· Knowledge/Office: the offline Office engine is prewarmed — documents open on a snapshot and become interactive seamlessly, with the engine's English menus and toolbars hidden
· Home: the guide shows at most five engine pills, the rest behind "More"
· Teams: an opt-in auto-staffing switch lets the system staff the team for the leader

[Improved]
· Knowledge: library items can be added to a conversation from the sidebar and document page; the list is tighter and follows the app theme
· Knowledge/retrieval: in-memory vector ranking, covering indexes and batched embeddings speed up search; Chinese questions match by trigram, the local model uses smaller chunks; quick embedding setup is validated and model channels are reused
· Knowledge/imports: large imports are cancellable and no longer hang; originals are read in slices and parsed in a worker, never re-downloaded; files whose indexing once failed are re-queued on the next import
· Preview: the default text preview limit rises from 1 MB to 5 MB
· Teams: members write early, self-check loops are capped, one deliverable by default; the no-op welcome turn is gone and dependencies route through the task board; members always reply in the user's language
· Digital employees: built-in role guides bind correctly and customer settings survive upgrades

[Fixed]
· Teams: manually added experts and spawned teammates follow the leader's real model (no longer misled by the roster seed); the member picker lists experts without a search
· Teams/MCP: team MCP revocation takes effect immediately, including cached tools and snapshots; distributed team skills resolve and required team guidance is injected
· Knowledge: cold-start query embeddings are no longer dropped; market entries that clash by name import under a source-labelled name instead of being skipped
· Bots: repeated pairing approvals preserve the expiry reason
· Home/sidebar: failed history loads surface clearly; the default model no longer drifts
· Skills: CJK payloads passed through the command line no longer turn into '?' (Windows pipe encoding fix)
· Stability: a damaged database file is reported as such instead of a bare 500; dependency upgrades fix known advisories

Enterprise governance gets stronger: conversations clearly say when a terminal command awaits administrator approval, company knowledge bases gain whole-folder imports from registered file storage and PDF text imports, and audit logs can be forwarded to SIEM; company renames, directory syncs, connectors and permissions see many fixes.

[New]
· Approvals: when a terminal command waits for a company administrator, the conversation (including ACP chats) says why; approval titles are readable and stale approval holds no longer stick
· Knowledge: an entire folder of a registered file storage can be imported into the company knowledge base; PDF imports read the text layer and large documents embed on a CPU server; the console offers .pdf and explains what a PDF import can read
· Audit: audit logs can be forwarded to the company's SIEM, and the console shows whether export is actually delivering
· Connectors: the card keeps the result and says what to do next; saved secrets show masked; GitHub/GitLab/Jira connectivity is judged on the token, not on the host answering

[Improved]
· Console: enterprise storage and personal vault navigation are unified; local workspace tabs consolidate related functions; startup resources split and settings sections consolidate; member table headers are restrained and refocusing the window no longer rebuilds the page
· Console: embedding setup is simpler with searchable model selection; legacy browser users get guidance before upgrading

[Fixed]
· Permissions: employee distribution and knowledge editing are secured; enterprise knowledge indexing is bounded and team task boundaries preserved; admin authority is aligned
· Directory: signed-in directory members bind on login; repeated syncs within one clock tick are distinguished; company permissions and the searchable member mapping align
· Company: a company rename carries through to its workspace name
· MCP: cached company MCP runtimes retire immediately after revocation
· SSO: SSO placement is preserved and every successful login is audited
· Security: an IP allowlist that would lock its own author out is refused; dependency upgrades fix known advisories
· Storage: WebDAV names containing # ? % are readable again; MySQL migrations apply again; enterprise PDFs render without browser plugins; conflicting drafts and source-only document state are preserved; name-clashed market entries show where they were imported
